articles.title: In Odesa, no-one is safe from Russia's new Black Sea strikes

articles.summary: インド人ジャーナリストのタルン・テジパル氏がレイプで懲役10年の判決を受けた。本人は容疑を否認しており、インド最高裁判所に上訴できる。

articles.summary: ミュンヘンの裁判所は、2025年に発生し母子を死亡させ多数の負傷者を出した自動車暴走事件の加害者に対し、最も厳しい終身刑を言い渡した。

articles.summary: 原爆投下記念日に、広島の被爆者と活動家たちは、日本の軍備増強が長年の平和主義へのコミットメントを損なうリスクがあると警告した。

articles.title: ‘Morocco feels emboldened’: Trump’s influence in spotlight after Ceuta disaster
articles.description:
Washington-Rabat ties under scrutiny as questions swirl over what led to deadly  influx into tiny Spanish territory
The cosy relationship between Washington and Rabat has long been flaunted by both sides, from Morocco’s announcement this year that it would be the first African state to join Donald Trump’s Board of Peace to the congratulatory message recently sent by Trump to mark King Mohammed VI’s 27 years in power.
The latest example landed this week. As Spain grappled with the aftermath of the sudden influx – and swift return – of more than 70,000 people into Ceuta, Morocco’s monarch confirmed he had named a $1bn highway flanking the disputed territory of Western Sahara after Trump.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「モロッコが強気になった」：セウタの惨事後、トランプの影響が焦点に
articles.summary: モロッコと米国の関係、特にトランプ前大統領の影響が注目されている。モロッコはセウタへの大量流入後、西サハラの高速道路をトランプ氏にちなんで命名し、その行動が国際関係に波紋を広げている。

articles.title: US to shut five consulates as critics fear China could fill diplomatic vacuum
articles.description:
State department informs Congress of planned closures in Canada, Grenada, Japan, Indonesia and Cameroon
The US state department is to shut five foreign consulates and missions across Asia, Africa, North America and the Caribbean, drawing criticism that it is leaving a diplomatic vacuum at risk of being filled by China.
The US Congress has been served notice of the impending closures, which are being justified on cost grounds and follow a reassessment of the US’s bilateral relationships with a range of countries since Donald Trump returned to the White House in January 2025.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国、5つの領事館閉鎖へ 中国が外交的空白を埋める可能性を懸念する声も

articles.title: El Niño could push 50m people into acute hunger before end of next year
articles.description:
UN forecasters warn of worsening conditions in 45 countries currently experiencing severe food insecurity
About 50 million people are likely to be pushed into acute hunger before the end of next year by the rapidly developing El Niño weather system, according to forecasting.
This is in addition to the hundreds of millions of people already facing dangerous levels of hunger, owing to years of drought in parts of Africa and pressure on food prices from the war in Iran.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: エルニーニョ現象、来年末までに5000万人を深刻な飢餓に追い込む可能性
articles.summary: 国連の予測によると、エルニーニョ現象により来年末までに約5000万人が深刻な飢餓に直面する恐れがある。アフリカの干ばつやイラン紛争による食料価格高騰も重なり、世界規模の食料危機が懸念されている。

articles.title: Wednesday briefing: ​How misinformation and ​a​ hardened immigration policy ​turned Ceuta ​into Europe’s ​latest ​flashpoint
articles.description:
In today’s newsletter: The past week shows how quickly images, rumours and ​right-wing political opportunism can eclipse the facts on the ground
Good morning. Last week, an estimated 72,000 migrants began crossing into a tiny Spanish enclave on the tip of Morocco. Within 24 hours, most of them had headed home. At least 88 people died after attempting the crossing, according to local officials. This isn’t the whole story of what happened over the last week, but the facts are worth remembering.
At an emergency meeting yesterday, EU interior ministers sought to draw a line under Ceuta, insisting that the passport-free Schengen area had never been at risk from the arrival of migrants at this scale. Despite this, much of the media coverage has suggested that events in Ceuta represent a territorial threat to Europe, sparking calls for greater security across the region’s borders.
Environment | Eight of the biggest oil companies amassed profits of more than $90bn (£67bn) in just three months as the Iran conflict sent energy prices soaring and the emissions-fuelled climate crisis caused deadly heatwaves.
UK politics | Women should not feel pressurised into experiencing an “ideal birth”, the new health secretary, Yvette Cooper, has said, promising a root-and-branch reform of standards after several damning maternity scandals.
Middle East | Jordan is convening an emergency meeting over an “imminent” threat of an Israeli takeover of the most important Muslim site in Jerusalem, with the potential to “trigger a religious conflict”.
Ukraine | Russian strikes in and around Kyiv killed at least 14 people, ⁠injured 27 and ⁠damaged warehouses, ​emergency service officials said. Some reports put the death toll at 15.
Ceuta | Hundreds of people have gathered in the northern Moroccan town of Fnideq, near the border with Spain’s Ceuta, flashing photos of their missing loved ones to passersby in the hope of tracking them down.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 水曜日のブリーフィング：誤報と厳格な移民政策がセウタを欧州最新の火種に変えた経緯
articles.summary: 誤報と厳格な移民政策が、モロッコ沖のスペイン領セウタを欧州の新たな火種に変えた経緯を解説。7万2千人以上の移民が流入し、EU内で緊急対応が協議された。他にも環境、英国政治、中東、ウクライナ情勢の概要が報じられている。

articles.title: Hundreds in Morocco gather near Ceuta border in anxious wait for missing loved ones
articles.description:
People hope to see friends or relatives among those still returning as death toll from mass crossing nears 100
Hundreds of people have gathered in the northern Moroccan town of Fnideq, near the border with Spain’s Ceuta, flashing photos of their missing loved ones to passersby in the hope of tracking them down.
Their perch was the same small tranche of land that made headlines around the world last week as extraordinary scenes emerged of about 72,000 people making their way into Ceuta, a tiny Spanish territory in north Africa.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: モロッコ、セウタ国境付近に数百人が集結、行方不明の愛する人を不安げに待つ
articles.summary: モロッコのフニデク近郊で、セウタへの大規模な越境後に消息を絶った家族や友人を待つ人々数百人が集まっている。約7万2千人がセウタへ渡り、死者も出ており、国境付近では深い悲しみと不安が広がっている。

articles.title: Toronto zoo announces birth of pygmy hippo calf, third for mother Kindia
articles.description:
The 20-year-old’s third calf is being monitored by officials as survival rates for the species are challenging, the zoo said
The Toronto Zoo has announced the birth of a female pygmy hippo calf.
Kindia, the zoo’s 20-year-old pygmy hippo, started showing signs of labor at around 8.15am last Sunday, it said. Around four hours later, the calf’s feet emerged and after 1.5 hours of active labor, Kindia successfully gave birth to the baby pygmy hippo.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トロント動物園、コビトカバの赤ちゃん誕生を発表 母親キンディアにとって3度目
articles.summary: トロント動物園は、母親キンディアからメスのコビトカバの赤ちゃんが生まれたことを発表した。20歳のキンディアにとって3度目の出産となり、絶滅危惧種の保護における重要な出来事として注目されている。

articles.title: Mexican influencer shot dead while streaming live on social media
articles.description:
César Gastélum was filming outside a fast-food outlet in Sinaloa state when he was killed by a motorbike driver
A popular Mexican influencer has been shot dead while doing a live stream on social media outside a restaurant in Sinaloa state, where lethal cartel violence has become widespread.
César Gastélum, who had nearly 600,000 followers on TikTok and was known for making comedy videos, was filming with two friends outside a fast-food restaurant in the city of Culiacán. The three were dressed in the bright orange jackets and backpacks of food delivery drivers.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: メキシコのインフルエンサー、ソーシャルメディアのライブ配信中に射殺される
articles.summary: メキシコのシナルア州で、人気インフルエンサーのセサル・ガステルム氏がファストフード店前でのライブ配信中に射殺された。この地域では麻薬カルテルによる暴力が蔓延しており、その犠牲となったとみられる。

articles.title: Peruvian cardinal hails $150m lead poisoning settlement for 1,300 people as a ‘historic milestone’
articles.description:
Cardinal Pedro Barreto received death threats and harassment during his almost 20-year campaign against a US mining company’s operations in the Andes
A Peruvian cardinal who received a barrage of death threats when he challenged the firm behind a toxic smelter has called a $150m (£111m) out-of-court settlement to more than 1,000 people who were allegedly poisoned by the plant as children “a historic milestone”.
Cardinal Pedro Barreto, 82, was in Rome meeting Pope Leo XIV and other cardinals in June when he received news that the firm that ran the smelter, the Doe Run Company, a subsidiary of Renco Group, would pay $150m to 1,373 Peruvians who have suffered health impacts since childhood.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ペルーの枢機卿、1300人の鉛中毒被害者への1億5000万ドルの和解を「歴史的節目」と称賛
articles.summary: ペルーのペドロ・バレット枢機卿が、有毒な精錬所による鉛中毒被害者1300人に対する1億5000万ドルの和解を「歴史的節目」と評価した。長年のキャンペーンが実を結び、幼少期から健康被害に苦しんできた人々に正義がもたらされた。

articles.title: Mexico’s top university orders 58,000 students to resit entrance exam after suspected cheating
articles.description:
National Autonomous University of Mexico says applicants must take test in person after online debacle
Mexico’s largest and most prestigious university has announced that about 58,000 students will have to resit their entrance exam after abnormally high test results raised suspicions of widespread cheating.
The National Autonomous University of Mexico (Unam) said the exam would take place in person after its first attempt at a fully remote online version led to a debacle and thousands of annulled results.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: メキシコ最高峰大学、5万8000人の学生に入学試験の再受験を命じる 不正行為が疑われるため
articles.summary: メキシコ国立自治大学は、大規模な不正行為の疑いから、5万8000人もの学生に入学試験の再受験を命じた。初のオンライン形式が問題となり、多数の結果が無効になったため、対面での再試験が実施される。

articles.title: US revokes Brazil ambassador’s visa in escalation of diplomatic feud
articles.description:
Move is retaliation for Lula’s government refusal to approve Trump’s nominee for ambassador in Brasília
Donald Trump’s administration has revoked the visa of Brazil’s ambassador to the US in a sharp escalation of a diplomatic feud with the country’s president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
The US state department said Maria Luiza Ribeiro Viotti’s visa had been cancelled in retaliation for Brazil’s refusal to approve Trump’s nominee for ambassador in Brasília and its decision last month to deny visas to two US diplomats seeking to visit ahead of an October election.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国、ブラジル大使のビザを取り消し 外交摩擦が激化
articles.summary: トランプ政権が、ブラジルのルラ政権との外交摩擦を激化させ、駐米ブラジル大使のビザを取り消した。これは、ブラジルが米国の次期大使候補を承認しなかったことへの報復措置とみられている。

articles.title: Moment rare Amur tiger is released into Kazakh wild

articles.titleJa: 珍しいアムールトラがカザフの野生に放たれる瞬間

articles.title: Electric scooters: Lime, Bird and Dott fined €2.6 million in Rome

articles.titleJa: 電動スクーター企業：ライム、バード、ドットがローマで260万ユーロの罰金

articles.title: Russia requests dispute panel on EU carbon border adjustment and emissions trading scheme
articles.description: At a meeting of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on 24 July, members considered a request from the Russian Federation for the establishment of a dispute panel to review the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Package and alleged export subsidy under the EU scheme for trading greenhouse gas emission allowances. The DSB Chair, Ambassador Guilherme de Aguiar Patriota (Brazil), also updated members on dispute settlement reform consultations and convened an informal discussion after the meeting to further hear members' views.
articles.titleJa: ロシア、EUの炭素国境調整メカニズムと排出量取引制度に関する紛争パネルを要請
articles.summary: ロシアはWTO紛争解決機関に対し、EUの炭素国境調整メカニズムと排出量取引制度に関する紛争パネル設置を要請。DSB議長は紛争解決改革協議も報告した。

articles.title: Why is transit in goods free but trade is not?
articles.description: In my previous two posts on the value of the WTO, I argued that when governments set trade policies independently, they focus on domestic effects but often overlook the costs imposed on trading partners. International trade agreements help governments take account of these cross-border spillovers (terms-of-trade externalities) by encouraging reciprocal negotiations over trade policy. While these negotiations will reduce trade protection, they will not necessarily lead to free trade. But if governments do not generally commit themselves to free trade, why has freedom of transit for goods been seen differently?
articles.titleJa: なぜ物品の通過は自由なのに、貿易はそうではないのか？
articles.summary: 記事は、各国政府が個別に貿易政策を決定する際に、貿易相手国への影響を軽視しがちであると指摘。物品の自由な通過と貿易の自由化の違いを問いかける。

articles.title: Updated WTO-IMF TPA Index shows continued rise in global trade policy activity
articles.description: A new Trade Policy Activity (TPA) index by WTO and IMF economists shows a marked rise in trade policy activity during 2025-26, alongside heightened trade policy tensions among large economies, against the backdrop of an overall upward trend.
articles.titleJa: WTO・IMFの最新TPA指数、世界の貿易政策活動の継続的な増加を示す
articles.summary: WTOとIMFの新たな貿易政策活動（TPA）指数は、2025-26年に貿易政策活動が著しく増加し、主要経済国間の貿易政策緊張が高まっていることを示す。

articles.title: Members review notifications, pandemic preparedness, biodiversity and IP office cooperation
articles.description: At a meeting of the Council for Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS) on 22-23 July, members discussed notifications of intellectual property legislation, pandemic preparedness, technology transfer, the relationship between the TRIPS Agreement and the Convention on Biological Diversity , and cooperation among IP offices. The meeting, chaired by Ambassador Alaa Hegazy (Egypt), also featured updates on technical cooperation and on a side event on genetic resources held the previous day. Members exchanged views and shared practical experiences from a recent workshop on technology transfer and cooperation initiatives.
articles.titleJa: メンバーは通知、パンデミック対策、生物多様性、知財庁協力について検討
articles.summary: TRIPS理事会は、知財法規の通知、パンデミック対策、技術移転、TRIPS協定と生物多様性条約の関係、知財庁協力など幅広い議題を議論した。
